patches.name: Bypass 'Please connect to Ableton Live' Popup Lockout in UI::switchPage
patches.description: Prevents UI::switchPage (0x600b0b86) from redirecting CPageSession (r4+0x468) to CPageLivePopUp (r4+0x6fcc) when Ableton Live's proprietary SysEx 0x1B handshake has not been received. Unlocks Session grid pads, scene launch, and track buttons in any DAW.

patches.name: Disable Param 0xC8 (isLiveDisconnected) Forced Redirect to CPageLivePopUp
patches.description: Prevents parameter 0xC8 handler (0x600b11de) from forcing a page switch to CPageLivePopUp when operating in Bitwig, Reaper, or other DAWs.

patches.name: Redirect Mode Index 5 (LivePopUp) to CPageSession in UI::switchPageByIndex
patches.description: Rewrites case 5 in UI::switchPageByIndex (0x600b107e) to target CPageSession (r0+0x468) instead of CPageLivePopUp (r0+0x6fcc).

patches.name: Unlock Device Control Page (CPageDevice) in Standalone/Custom Mode
patches.description: Allows entering Device Control page (r0+0x200) regardless of Standalone/DAW mode.

patches.name: Unlock Mixer Page (CPageMixer) in Standalone/Custom Mode
patches.description: Allows entering Mixer page (r0+0x334) regardless of Standalone/DAW mode.

patches.name: Enable Touchstrip Faders to Transmit MIDI CC1/CC2 & Notes in All Modes
patches.description: Restructures the Touchstrip Fader handler (0x600b1a80) so that in DAW/Session/Mixer/Device modes it calls BOTH 0x600b2e60 (DAW fader port 0) AND 0x600ada00 (Custom MIDI CC1/CC2 + Fader Note on USB Custom port 3, DIN MIDI, and CV). Allows instant MIDI CC learn in Bitwig, Reaper, or any VST synth in every mode.

patches.name: Allow SysEx 0x19 (Set Active UI Page) in Both DAW and Standalone Modes
patches.description: Removes the Device Mode == Standalone guard on SysEx message 0x19 (0x600bcfa0) so the Web Project Editor and external DAW scripts can switch hardware pages at any time.

patches.name: Update Global Settings Device Mode OLED Label to 'Universal DAW'
patches.description: Replaces 'Ableton Live' with 'Universal DAW' in the hardware OLED Global Settings menu.

patches.name: Update OLED Banner Strings to FreeAPC64 Universal DAW
patches.description: Updates the OLED status strings to identify FreeAPC64 v0.1 Universal DAW firmware.
